originalTitle: Grand Theft Auto VI is Full of Things You’d Never Notice
content: #YouTubePartner I helped run the NEWSROOM on YouTube's Grand Theft Auto VI launch livestream the other day, and my wonderful research team that I hired for it found WAY more than we could fit on air. So here’s what we cut. Gracias to YouTube for inviting us to Miami, supporting our travel, and having us on the launch livestream. If you want all the best GTAVI content, YouTube is the place to watch it. And yes this is an ad but I do love YouTube. Watch the full launch livestream: https://youtu.be/vFIEvLIlwhM Research Lead: Van Hernandez Researchers: Kelsi S, Tom McNix, Cody B, Gabby B, Gale B, Luis P. YouTube Livestream Producer: Phil Lorigo On-Site Production Support: David Keller and Gwen Moore On-Site Logistics: Ryan B With Additional Coordination and Support from Algebra Media Lead Editor: William H Design/Graphics: Sadie W Operations: Ashlyn K Creative Support: Luke D #GTA6 #GrandTheftAutoVI
